_notes: Hardened: explicit TDS/IBC provisions, representation and warranty clause, FEMA compliance for cross-border.

conditional_clauses.note: NBFC must follow RBI KYC/AML and data norms (dedicated clause).
Security / collateral — included ONLY for secured loans. is_secured is derived from collateral being present.
Foreign lender / overseas funds → FEMA + ECB compliance.
SARFAESI enforcement rights for scheduled banks / NBFCs only (clause self-limits to eligible lenders).

mandatory_legal_checks: Interest rate must not exceed usurious threshold — Usurious Loans Act 1918
TDS on interest payment — IT Act S.194A — must be addressed
FEMA compliance required if lender is foreign entity or funds are from abroad
SARFAESI applicability — only for scheduled banks and NBFCs, not private lenders
Stamp duty on loan agreement — varies by state and loan amount
